# Malman Law

> > Chicago-based personal injury law firm with 25,000+ clients specializing in medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, product liability, and wrongful death cases with over $750 million in settlements.

Malman Law is a full-service personal injury law firm founded by Steven J. Malman, operating in Chicago, Champaign, and Rockford, Illinois. The firm offers bilingual legal services and operates on a contingency fee basis, meaning clients pay no upfront costs.

## Core Practice Areas

- [Personal Injury](https://www.malmanlaw.com/personal-injury): Personal injury law services: nursing home, medical malpractice, wrongful death
- [Product Liability Lawyer](https://www.malmanlaw.com/product-liability-lawyer): Product liability lawyer: Monsanto Round-Up and defective products cases
- [Construction Accidents Lawyer](https://www.malmanlaw.com/construction-accidents-lawyer): Construction accident lawyer: workplace injuries with 95% success rate
- [Spinal Cord Injuries Lawyer](https://www.malmanlaw.com/spinal-cord-injuries-lawyer): Spinal cord injury attorney: paralysis and workplace injury settlements
- [Slip and Fall Injury Lawyer](https://www.malmanlaw.com/slip-fall-lawyer): Slip and fall injury lawyer: premises liability and accident compensation
- [Dog Bite Attorneys](https://www.malmanlaw.com/dog-bite-attacks-lawyer): Dog bite injury lawyer in Chicago: free case evaluation and compensation
